an8.2:10.2: “Why, sir, does it say this? What does that mean?”
an8.2:10.3: Those venerables reveal to them what is hidden, clarify what is unclear, and dispel doubt regarding the many doubtful matters.
an8.2:16.2: Such is form, such is the origin of form, such is the disappearance of form;
an8.2:16.6: Such is consciousness, such is the origin of consciousness, such is the disappearance of consciousness.
